ई: 1. ई the fourth letter of the alphabet, corresponding to इ long, and having the sound of ee in feel.
2. ई m. N. of Kandarpa, the god of love, L.
ई f. (ई or ईस्) N. of Lakṣmī, L. ([also in MBh. xiii 1220, according to, Nīlak. (who reads पुण्यचञ्चुर् ई)]).
3. ई ind. an interjection of pain or anger
a particle implying consciousness or perception, consideration, compassion.
ईकार: ई—कार m. the letter or sound ई.
ईक्ष्: ईक्ष् cl. 1. Ā. ई॑क्षते, ईक्षां-चक्रे (Pāṇ. i, 3, 63), ईक्षिष्यते, ऐक्षिष्ट, ईक्षितुम्, to see, look, view, behold, look at, gaze at; to watch over (with acc. or rarely loc.), AV.; AitBr.; ŚBr.; Mn.; Kathās. &c.; to see in one's mind, think, have a thought, ŚBr.; ChUp.; MBh.; Bhag. &c.; to regard, consider, Kum.; to observe (the stars &c.), VarBṛS.; to foretell for (dat.; lit. to observe the stars for any one), Pāṇ. i, 4, 39 : Caus. ईक्षयति, to make one look at (with acc.), ĀśvGṛ. (This root is perhaps connected with अक्षि q.v.)
ईक्ष: ई॑क्ष mf(ई)n. ifc. seeing, looking, visiting (See तिर्यग्-ईक्ष, वध्व्-ईक्ष)
ई॑क्ष n. anything seen, ŚBr. vii, 1, 2, 23 (merely for the etym. of अन्तरिक्ष).
ईक्षक: ई॑क्षक m. a spectator, beholder, ŚBr.; ĀśvGṛ.; Gobh.
ईक्षण: ईक्षण n. a look, view, aspect sight, KātyŚr.; Lāṭy.; Kathās.; Pañcat.; Ratnāv. &c.
regarding, looking after, caring for, Mn.
ईक्षणिक: ईक्षणिक, अस्, आ, m. f. and ईक्षणीक, m. a looker into the future, a fortune-teller, VarBṛS.
ईक्षणीक: ईक्षणिक, अस्, आ, m. f. and ईक्षणीक, m. a looker into the future, a fortune-teller, VarBṛS.
ईक्षणीय: ईक्षणीय mfn. to be seen or perceived.
ईक्षमाण: ईक्षमाण mfn. looking at, surveying, VS.; R.
ईक्षित: ईक्षित n. a look, Śak. 45 a; Prab.
ईक्षितृ: ईक्षितृ mfn. seeing, beholding, a beholder, Mn.; Prab. &c.
ईक्षेण्य: ईक्षे॑ण्य mfn. deserving to be seen, curious, RV. ix, 77, 3.
ईक्ष्यमाण: ईक्ष्यमाण mfn. being beheld, being viewed.
ईख्: ईख् or इख् cl. 1. P. एखति, इयेख, or ईखति, ईखां-चकार, एखितुम् or ईखितुम्, to go, move, Dhātup. v, 28.
ईङ्ख्: ईङ्ख् or इङ्ख् cl. 1. P. (इङ्खति, इङ्खां-चकार, or ईङ्खति, ईङ्खां-चकार, इङ्खितुम् or ईङ्खितुम्) to go, move, Dhātup. v, 28 : Caus. ईङ्ख॑यति, to move backwards and forwards, move up and down, swing, RV.; AitBr.
ईङ्खय: ईङ्खय mfn. moving, causing to flow or go.
ईज्: ईज् or ईञ्ज् cl. 1. P. ईजति, ईजां-चकार, ईजितुम् or ईञ्जति, &c., to go; to blame or censure, Dhātup. vi, 24 (cf. अपेज् and सम्-ईज्.)
ईञ्ज्: ईज् or ईञ्ज् cl. 1. P. ईजति, ईजां-चकार, ईजितुम् or ईञ्जति, &c., to go; to blame or censure, Dhātup. vi, 24 (cf. अपेज् and सम्-ईज्.)
ईजान: ईजान॑ mfn. (pf. p. of √ यज् q.v.) one who has sacrificed, RV.; AV.; ŚBr. &c.
ईजितुम्: ईजितुम् (irr. inf. of √ यज् q.v.) = यष्टुम्.
ईजिक: ईजिक m. pl. N. of a people, VP.; MBh.
ईड्: 1. ईड् cl. 2. Ā. ई॑ट्टे (2. sg. pres. ईडिषे, Ved. ईळिषे pf. ईडे॑ fut. ईडिष्यते aor. ऐडिष्ट. inf. ईडितुम्, Ved. ईळे, &c.) to implore, request, ask for (with two acc.); to praise, RV.; AV.; VS.; R.; BhP. &c.: Caus. P. ईडयति, to ask; to praise, BhP.
2. ईड् f. praise, extolling, RV. viii, 39, 1.
ईडन: ईडन n. the act of praising, L.
ईडित: ईडित or ईळित॑, mfn. implored, requested, RV.
ईळित: ईडित or ईळित॑, mfn. implored, requested, RV.
ईडितृ: ईडितृ॑ mfn. one who praises, AV. iv, 31, 4.
ईडेन्य: ईडे॑न्य or ईळेन्य or ईड्य, mfn. to be invoked or implored
to be praised or glorified, praiseworthy, laudable, RV.; AV.; VS.; ŚBr.; Ragh. &c.
ईळेन्य: ईडे॑न्य or ईळेन्य or ईड्य, mfn. to be invoked or implored
to be praised or glorified, praiseworthy, laudable, RV.; AV.; VS.; ŚBr.; Ragh. &c.
ईड्य: ईडे॑न्य or ईळेन्य or ईड्य, mfn. to be invoked or implored
to be praised or glorified, praiseworthy, laudable, RV.; AV.; VS.; ŚBr.; Ragh. &c.
ईति: 1. ईति f. (fr. 4. ई?), plague, distress, any calamity of the season (as drought, excessive rain, swarm of rats, foreign invasion, &c.)
travelling in foreign countries, sojourning, L.
ईदृक्ष: ईदृ॑क्ष mf(ई)n. (fr. इद्, neut. of pronom. base 3. इ, and दृक्ष, √ दृश्, dropping one द् and lengthening the preceding इ; cf. तदृक्ष from तद्, &c.), of this aspect, of such a kind, endowed with such qualities, such-like, VS.; Kathās. &c.
ईदृगवस्थ: ईदृग्-अवस्थ mfn. being in such a situation, Vṛṣabhān.
ईदृश्: ई-दृ॑श् mfn. क् (Ved. ङ्, Pāṇ. vii, 1, 83) endowed with such qualities, such, VS.; TS.; ŚBr.; Śak.; Pañcat. &c.
ई-दृ॑श् f. (क्) such a condition, such occasion, RV.; AV.
ईदृश: ईदृ॑श, mf(ई)n. or ईदृशक, mf(इका)n. endowed with such qualities, such, ŚBr.; ChUp.; Mn.; R.; Bhag. : Śak. &c.

ईदृश [with the final syllables दृश् and दृश of these words cf. the Gk. λικ in ὑμῆλιξ, λικο in τηλίκο-ς &c.; Goth. leika in hvêleiks, ‘which one’, svaleik-s, ‘such’; Mod. Germ. welcher, solcher; Slav. liko nom. lik e.g. tolik, ‘such’; Lat. li in tâlis, quâlis.]
ईदृशभूत: ईदृश-भूत mfn. being such a one, Naiṣ.
ईदृशक: ईदृ॑श, mf(ई)n. or ईदृशक, mf(इका)n. endowed with such qualities, such, ŚBr.; ChUp.; Mn.; R.; Bhag. : Śak. &c.
ईन्त्: ईन्त् cl. 1. P. ईन्तति, ईन्तितुम्, to bind ([cf. अन्त् and अन्द्]), Vop. on Dhātup. iii, 25.
ईप्स्: ईप्स् (Desid. of √ आप् q.v.), to wish to obtain.
ईप्सन: ईप्सन n. desiring or wishing to obtain, L.
ईप्सा: ईप्सा f. asking, desire or wish to obtain, MBh.; R.
ईप्सित: ईप्सित n. desire, wish, MBh.; R.; Ragh.; Kathās.
ईप्सिततम: ईप्सित—तम mfn. most desired, immediately aimed at (as the object of an action), Pāṇ. i, 4, 49.
ईप्सु: wishing to get or obtain, desirous of (with acc.), Mn.; MBh.; Ragh.; R. &c.
ईप्सुयज्ञ: ईप्सु—यज्ञ m. a particular Soma sacrifice, KātyŚr.
ईम्: ईम् ind. (fr. pronominal base 3. इ), Ved. a particle of affirmation and restriction (generally after short words at the beginning of a period, or after the relative pronouns, the conjunction यद्, prepositions and particles such as आत्, उत, अथ, &c.) ईम् has also the sense ‘now’ (= इदानीम्), and is by, Sāy. sometimes considered as an acc. case for एनम्, RV.; VS.
ईंकार: ईं—कार॑ m. uttering the exclamation ईम्, TS.
ईंकृत: ईं—कृत (ईं॑-), mfn. one who has uttered ईम्, ib. 2.
ईयक्षमाण: ईयक्षमाण = इ॑यक्षमाण (fr. इयक्ष्) q.v., MaitrS. ii, 10, 6.
ईयचक्षस्: ईय-चक्षस् mfn. (ईय fr. √ इ), of pervading or far-reaching sight, RV. v, 66, 6.
ईयिवस्: ईयिवस् mfn. (ईयिवान्, ईयुषी, ईयिवत्) (pf. p. of √ इ) one who has gone
ईर्: ईर् cl. 2. Ā. ई॑र्ते (3. pl. ई॑रते, AV.; RV.), इरं-चक्रे, इरिष्यति, ऐरिष्ट, ईरितुम्;  Ved. inf. इर॑ध्यै, RV. i, 134, 2, to go, move, rise, arise from, RV.; to go away, retire, AV. xix, 38, 2; to agitate, elevate, raise (one's voice), RV. : Caus. P. ईर॑यति (cf. √ ईल्), to agitate, throw, cast; to excite, RV.; AV.; MBh.; R. &c.; to cause to rise; to bring to life;  to raise one's voice, utter, pronounce, proclaim, cite, RV.; ChUp.; Ragh.; Suśr. &c. ; to elevate, RV.; VS.; TS.; ŚBr. : Ā. to raise one's self, AV.; VS.
ईरयध्यै: ईरय॑ध्यै (Ved. inf. of Caus. of √ ईर्), to set in motion, RV. iv, 2, 1.
ईरण: painful and laborious evacuation of the bowels, Bhpr.
ईरिताकूत: ईरिताकूत n. declared purpose or intention.
ईर्यता: ईर्य—ता (ईर्य॑°) f. the condition of one who is to be excited, VS.; AitĀr.
ईर्या: ईर्या f. wandering about as a religious mendicant (i.e. without hurting any creature).
ईर्यापथ: ईर्या—पथ m. the observances of a religious mendicant
the four positions of the body (viz. going, standing upright, sitting and lying down), Buddh. and, Jain. (cf. ऐर्यापथिकी.)
ईरामा: ईरामा f. N. of a river, MBh.
ईरिण: ईरिण n. salt and barren soil (See इरिण), MBh.
ईरिन्: ईरिन् m. N. of a man
m. pl. (इणस्) the descendants of this man, MBh.
ईर्क्ष्य्: ईर्ष्य् or ईर्क्ष्य् cl. 1. P. ई॑र्ष्यति (p. ई॑र्ष्यत्, TS.), ईर्ष्यां-चकार, ईष्यितुम् or ईर्क्ष्यति, Pāṇ.; Vop.; Dhātup.; to envy, feel impatient at another's prosperity (with dat.) : Desid. ईर्ष्यिषिषति or ईर्ष्यियिषति Comm. on Pāṇ.
ईर्त्स्: ईर्त्स् (Desid. of √ ऋध् q.v.) P. ईर्त्सति, to wish to increase, Pāṇ. vii, 4, 55; Vop.
ईर्त्सा: ईर्त्सा f. the wish to increase anything, L.
ईर्त्सु: ईर्त्सु mfn. wishing to increase anything, Bhaṭṭ.
ईर्म: 1. ईर्म॑ or ईर्मा॑, ind. or ईर्मा॑, in this place, here, to this place
2. ईर्म॑ m. the arm, the fore-quarter of an animal, AV. x, 10, 21; ŚBr.; TāṇḍyaBr.
ईर्म॑ n. a sore or wound, TāṇḍyaBr. iv, 2, 10 ([Sāy.])
ईर्मा: 1. ईर्म॑ or ईर्मा॑, ind. or ईर्मा॑, in this place, here, to this place
ईर्मान्त: ईर्मा॑न्त mfn. (fr. ईर्म = ईरित with अन्त, Sāy.), full-haunched (lit. full-ended, RV.)
(perhaps) having the biggest (or quickest?) horses on both sides of the team
N. of a team of horses or of the horses of the sun's car, RV. i, 163, 10.
ईर्वारु: ईर्वारु m. a cucumber, Cucumis Utilissimus, L. See इर्वारु.
ईर्ष्य्: ईर्ष्य् or ईर्क्ष्य् cl. 1. P. ई॑र्ष्यति (p. ई॑र्ष्यत्, TS.), ईर्ष्यां-चकार, ईष्यितुम् or ईर्क्ष्यति, Pāṇ.; Vop.; Dhātup.; to envy, feel impatient at another's prosperity (with dat.) : Desid. ईर्ष्यिषिषति or ईर्ष्यियिषति Comm. on Pāṇ.
ईर्षा: ईर्षा f. impatience, envy of another's success (more properly read ईर्ष्या), MBh.; R. &c.
ईर्षित: ईर्षित n. envy (v.l. for ईर्ष्यित q.v.), Hit.
ईर्षितव्य: ईर्षितव्य mfn. to be envied (v.l. for ईर्ष्यितव्य, q.v.), Prab.
ईर्षु: ईर्षु mfn. envious, jealous (v.l. for ईर्ष्यु q.v.), MBh.; Hit.
ईर्ष्या: ईर्ष्या॑ f. envy or impatience of another's success
ईर्ष्याभिरति: ईर्ष्याभिरति, ईर्ष्या-रति, and ईर्ष्या-षण्ढ, m. a kind of semi-impotent man, = ईर्ष्यक q.v., Car.; Nār.
ईर्ष्यारति: ईर्ष्याभिरति, ईर्ष्या-रति, and ईर्ष्या-षण्ढ, m. a kind of semi-impotent man, = ईर्ष्यक q.v., Car.; Nār.
ईर्ष्याषण्ढ: ईर्ष्याभिरति, ईर्ष्या-रति, and ईर्ष्या-षण्ढ, m. a kind of semi-impotent man, = ईर्ष्यक q.v., Car.; Nār.
ईर्ष्यक: ईर्ष्यक m. a particular kind of semi-impotent man whose power is stimulated through jealous feelings caused by seeing others in the act of sexual union, Suśr.
ईर्ष्यु: ईर्ष्यु॑ mfn. jealous, AV. vi, 18, 2; MBh.; Hit.
ईल्: ईल् Caus. P. ईल॑यति, to move, TS. vi, 4, 2, 6 (cf. ईर्, Caus.)
ईलिका: ईलिका f. a nerve, tendon, gut, L.
ईलिन: ईलिन m. N. of a son of Taṉsu and father of Duṣyanta, MBh.
ईलिनी: ईलिनी f. N. of a daughter of Medhātithi, Hariv.
ईली: ईली or ईलि f. a kind of weapon (sometimes considered as a cudgel and sometimes as a short sword or stick shaped like a sword), L.
ईलि: ईली or ईलि f. a kind of weapon (sometimes considered as a cudgel and sometimes as a short sword or stick shaped like a sword), L.
ईवत्: ई॑-वत् mfn. (fr. pronominal base 3. इ), so large, so stately, so magnificent, so much, RV.
ईश्: 1. ईश् cl. 2. Ā. ई॑ष्टे, or Ved. ई॑शे (2. sg. ई॑शिषे and ई॑क्षे, RV. iv, 20, 8; vi, 19, 10; Pot. 1. sg. ई॑शीय pf. 3. pl. ईशिरे, ईशिष्यति, ईशितुम्) to own, possess, RV.; MBh.; Bhaṭṭ.; to belong to, RV.; to dispose of, be valid or powerful; to be master of (with gen., or Ved. with gen. of an inf., or with a common inf., or the loc. of an abstract noun), RV.; AV.; TS.; ŚBr.; MBh.; Ragh. &c.; to command; to rule, reign, RV.; AV.; ŚBr. &c.; to behave like a master, allow, KaṭhUp.;
ईश् [cf. Goth. aigan, ‘to have’; Old Germ. eigan, ‘own’; Mod. Germ. eigen.]
2. ईश् m. master, lord, the supreme spirit, VS. &c.
ईशाध्याय: ईशाध्याय m. N. of the Īśā-upaniṣad.
ईशावास्य: ईशा-वास्य or ईशावास्य, n. ‘to be clothed or pervaded by the Supreme’, N. of the Īśopaniṣad (q.v.) which commences with that expression.
ईशोपनिषद्: ईशोपनिषद् f. N. of an Upaniṣad (so called from its beginning ईशा [VS. xl, 1]; the only instance of an Upaniṣad included in a Saṃhitā).
ईश: one who is completely master of anything
a ruler, master, lord, Mn.; ŚBr.; MBh.; Kum. &c.
the number ‘eleven’ (as there are eleven Rudras)
N. of Śiva as regent of the north-east quarter, MBh.; Hariv.; R.; Śak. &c.
ईशा: ईशा॑ f. faculty, power, dominion, AV.; VS.; ŚBr.
ईशगोचर: ईश—गोचर m. ‘Śiva's region’, the north-east, AgP.
ईशशक्ति: ईश—शक्ति f. the personified female energy of Śiva, L. (cf. RTL. 187)
ईशाधर: ई—°शाधर m. (with Buddhists) N. of one of the 8 mountains, Dharmas. 125
ईशेश्वर: ई°शेश्वर N. of a temple, Rājat.
ईशगीता: ईश॑—गीता f. pl. N. of a section of the Kūrma-purāṇa.
ईशसंस्थ: ईश॑—संस्थ mfn. appearing as lord, ŚvetUp.
ईशसखि: ईश॑—सखि m. Śiva's friend, N. of Kuvera.
ईशसरस्: ईश॑—सरस् n. N. of a lake.
ईशके: ईशके ind. in the northeast, AgP.
ईशान: ई॑शान ई॑शान (and ईशान॑) mfn. owning, possessing, wealthy
ई॑शान m. a ruler, master, one of the older names of Śiva-Rudra, AV.; VS.; ŚBr.; MBh.; Kum. &c.
the sun as a form of Śiva
ईशानी: ई॑शानी f. the silk-cotton tree, Bombax Heptaphyllum, L.
ईशानकल्प: ईशान—कल्प m. N. of a Kalpa.
ईशानकृत्: ईशान—कृ॑त् mfn. acting like a competent person, making use of one's possessions or faculties
rendering one a master or able ([Sāy.]), RV.
ईशानचन्द्र: ईशान—चन्द्र m. N. of a physician, Rājat.
ईशानज: ईशान—ज m. pl. a class of deities forming a section of the Kalpabhavas, L.
ईशानदिश्: ईशान—दिश् f. ‘Śiva's region’, the north-east, Hcat.
ईशानदेवी: ईशान—देवी f. N. of a woman, Rājat.
ईशानबलि: ईशान—बलि m. a particular sacrifice, VS.
ईशानहत: ईशान—हत mfn. killed by fever (= ज्वर-हत), Kauś. (Sch.).
ईशानाधिप: ईशानाधिप mfn. one whose lord is Śiva
ईशान्य: ईशान्य n. N. of a Liṅga.
ईशितव्य: ईशितव्य mfn. to be reigned or ruled over, BhP.
ईशितृ: ईशितृ m. a master, owner, proprietor
ईशिता: ईशि-ता, f. or ईशि-त्व, n. superiority, supremacy, one of the eight attributes of Śiva, MBh.; BhP.
ईशित्व: ईशि-ता, f. or ईशि-त्व, n. superiority, supremacy, one of the eight attributes of Śiva, MBh.; BhP.
ईश्वर: ईश्वर॑ mfn. able to do, capable of (with gen. of Vedic inf., or with common inf.), liable, exposed to, AV.; TS.; ŚBr.; AitBr.; Kum.; Hit. &c.
ईश्वर॑ mf(ई). master, lord, prince, king, mistress, queen, AV.; ŚBr.; Ragh.; Mn. &c.
the Supreme Being, Mn.; Suśr.; Yājñ. &c.
ईश्वर॑ f(आ or ई). N. of Durgā
of any other of the Śaktis or female energies of the deities
ईश्वरकारणिक: ईश्वर—कारणिक (Jātakam.), ईश्वर—कारणिन् (Śaṃk.), or ईश्वर—कारिन् (Hcar.), m. atheist
ईश्वरकारणिन्: ईश्वर—कारणिक (Jātakam.), ईश्वर—कारणिन् (Śaṃk.), or ईश्वर—कारिन् (Hcar.), m. atheist
ईश्वरकारिन्: ईश्वर—कारणिक (Jātakam.), ईश्वर—कारणिन् (Śaṃk.), or ईश्वर—कारिन् (Hcar.), m. atheist
ईश्वरकृष्ण: ईश्वर॑—कृष्ण m. N. of the author of the Sāṃkhya-kārikā.
ईश्वरगीता: ईश्वर॑—गीता f. pl. a section of the Kūrma-purāṇa.
ईश्वरता: ईश्वर॑—ता, f. or ईश्वर॑—त्व, n. superiority, supremacy, Prab.; MBh.; Hariv.; Mṛcch.
ईश्वरत्व: ईश्वर॑—ता, f. or ईश्वर॑—त्व, n. superiority, supremacy, Prab.; MBh.; Hariv.; Mṛcch.
ईश्वरतीर्थाचार्य: ईश्वर॑—तीर्थाचार्य m. N. of a teacher.
ईश्वरदत्त: ईश्वर॑—दत्त m. N. of a prince.
ईश्वरनिषेध: ईश्वर॑—निषेध m. denial of God, atheism.
ईश्वरप्रणिधान: ईश्वर॑—प्रणिधान n. devotion to God, Vedāntas.
ईश्वरप्रत्यभिज्ञासूत्र: ईश्वर—प्रत्यभिज्ञा-सूत्र n. N. of a Śaiva wk. by Utpala
ईश्वरभाव: ईश्वर॑—भाव m. royal or imperial state.
ईश्वरवर्मन्: ईश्वर॑—वर्मन् m. N. of a man, Kathās.
ईश्वरसभ: ईश्वर॑—सभ n. a royal court or assembly.
ईश्वरसूरि: ईश्वर॑—सूरि m. N. of a teacher.
ईश्वरसेन: ईश्वर॑—सेन m. N. of a king, VP.
ईश्वरसेवा: ईश्वर॑—सेवा f. the worship of God.
ईश्वराधीन: ईश्वराधीन mfn. subject to a king, dependant on a master or on God
ईश्वराधीनता: ईश्वराधीन—ता f. dependance upon God, subjection to a ruler.
ईश्वराधीनत्व: ईश्वराधीन—त्व n. dependance upon God, subjection to a ruler.
ईश्वरानन्द: ईश्वरानन्द m. N. of a scholiast.
ईश्वरीकृ: ईश्वरी-√ कृ to make any one a lord or master.
ईष्: 1. ईष् cl. 1. Ā. (with prep. also P.) ई॑षते, -ति (p. ई॑षमाण, RV.; AV.; ईषे॑, ईषितुम्) to go; to fly away, escape, RV.; AitBr.; to attack, hurt, TS.; to glean, collect a few grains; to look, Dhātup.
2. ईष् ind. a Nidhana or concluding chorus at the end of a Sāman, ĀrṣBr.
ईषत्: 2. ईष॑त् ind. (gaṇa स्वर्-आदि, Pāṇ. i, 1, 37; for the use of ईषत् See Pāṇ. iii, 3, 126, &c.) little, a little, slightly, ŚBr.; R.; Suśr. &c.
ईष: ईष m. the month Āśvina See इष
a son of the third Manu
ईषज्जल: ईष॑ज्-जल (ईषज्-जल) n. shallow water, a little water.
ईषत्कार्य: ईष॑त्—कार्य mfn. connected with slight effort.
ईषत्पाण्डु: ईष॑त्—पाण्डु m. a pale or light brown colour.
ईषत्पान: ईष॑त्—पान mfn. that of which a little is drunk
ईषत्प्रलम्भ: ईष॑त्—प्रलम्भ mfn. to be deceived easily.
ईषत्सदृश: ईषत्—सदृश mfn. a little like, ĀpY.
ईषत्स्पृष्ट: ईष॑त्—स्पृष्ट mfn. uttered with slight contact of the organs of speech (said of the semi-vowels), APrāt.; Siddh. &c.
ईषदसमाप्त: ईषद्—असमाप्त mfn. a little incomplete, not quite complete, almost complete,
ईषदसमाप्ति: ईषद्—असमाप्ति f. almost completeness or perfection, little defectiveness or imperfection, Pāṇ. v, 3, 67.
ईषदाढ्यंकर: ईषद्—आढ्यं-कर mfn. easy to be enriched Comm. on Pāṇ.
ईषदाढ्यंभव: ईषद्—आढ्यं-भव mfn. easy to become rich, ib.
ईषदुपदान: ईषद्—उपदान mfn. easy to be ruined, Kāś. on Pāṇ. vi, 1, 50.
ईषद्दर्शन: ईषद्—दर्शन n. a glance, a slight inspection.
ईषद्धास्य: ईषद्—धास्य n. slight laughter, a smile.
ईषद्बीजा: ईषद्—बीजा f. a species of grape (having no kernel), Nir.
ईषद्विवृत: ईषद्—विवृत mfn. uttered with slight opening of the organs of speech.
ईषन्नाद: ईषन्—नाद mfn. slightly sounding (applied to unaspirated soft consonants).
ईषन्निमय: ईषन्—निमय mfn. exchanged for a little, L.
ईषन्मर्ष: ईषन्—मर्ष or ईषन्—मर्षण, mfn. easy to be endured, tolerable, L.
ईषन्मर्षण: ईषन्—मर्ष or ईषन्—मर्षण, mfn. easy to be endured, tolerable, L.
ईषल्लभ: ईषल्-लभ (ईषत्-लभ) mfn. to be obtained for a little, L.
ईषा: ईषा॑ f. (said to be fr. 1. ईष्), the pole or shafts of a carriage or plough
f. du. (ए) the double or fork-shaped pole, RV. iii, 53, 17; viii, 5, 29; AV. viii, 8, 23
ईषादण्ड: ईषा॑—दण्ड m. the handle of a plough, VP.
ईषादन्त: ईषा॑—दन्त mfn. having tusks as long as a pole
ईषा॑—दन्त m. an elephant with a large tusk, MBh.; R.
ईषाधार: ईषाधार m. N. of a Nāga.
ईषिका: a weapon, a dart or arrow, L. Cf. इषीका and ईषीका.
ईषिर: ईषिर m. fire, L. See इषिर.
ईषीका: ईषी॑का f. a reed, cane, MaitrS.
a painter's brush or a fibrous stick used as one
a dipping rod or something cast into a crucible to examine if the metal it contains is in fusion, L. See ईक्षिका.
ईष्म: ईष्म and 1. ईष्व, m. N. of Kāmadeva
spring, L. See इष्म and इष्व.
ईष्व: ईष्म and 1. ईष्व, m. N. of Kāmadeva
spring, L. See इष्म and इष्व.
2. ईष्व m. a spiritual teacher, L.
ईसराफ: ईसराफ m. (fr. the Arab.), N. of the fourth Yoga (in astrol.)
ईह्: ईह् cl. 1. Ā. ईहते, ईहां-चक्रे, ईहिष्यते, ईहितुम्, rarely P. ईहति, &c., to endeavour to obtain; to aim at, attempt; to long for, desire; to take care of;  to have in mind, think of (with acc.), MBh.; R.; BhP.; Bhag.; Pañcat. &c. : Caus. ईहयति, to impel.
ईहा: ईहा f. effort, exertion, activity, Mn.; MBh.; R. &c.
request, desire, wish, R.; Sāh.; MBh. &c.
ईहतस्: ईह—तस् ind. diligently, energetically, by or with labour or exertion.
ईहामृग: ईहामृग m. a wolf, MBh.; R.
ईहार्थिन्: ईहार्थिन् mfn. aiming at any object, seeking wealth.
ईहालिह्: ईहा—लिह् mfn. reading (any one's) wish (नयनयोः, ‘in his eyes’; cf. 2. लिह्, p. 903), Sāh.
ईहित: ईहित mfn. sought, attempted, striven for
ईहित n. desire, request, wish, effort, Hit.; Kathās.; Prab. &c.
